blocks.text: MIAMI — Giannis Antetokounmpo has a big problem. Unwanted invaders were spotted recently in the backyard of his new Miami home, and that wasn’t an issue he had to deal with while playing in Milwaukee. Iguanas aren’t exactly a big problem in Wisconsin. In Miami, well, they’re everywhere — including around Antetokounmpo’s new pool, which led to a viral moment this past weekend when the new Heat star posted about his family’s encounter with the large lizard. “If the iguanas keep on coming, I’ll probably move, maybe get an apartment.
